artworks.title: Tower on the Horizon of a Lake (Tour a l'horizon d'un lac)
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape view with a slightly elevated perspective. There are sparse elements in the scene, including a faint silhouette of a structure to the right of the center. The sketch is created using varying densities of pen strokes to depict texture and form. The foreground features dense, energetic lines representing tree trunks and foliage, while the background shows an open expanse of land leading to the horizon. The color palette is monochromatic, with brown ink on light, off-white paper, giving the scene a sepia-toned quality.

artworks.title: The Poet and His Muse (Le Poete et la muse)
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape sketch with loose, expressive lines creating texture and form. The horizon is suggested by a gradual slope. In the distance, two figures are depicted in profile. Energetic crossed hatching gives a sense of movement and depth. The color palette is monochromatic, using shades of brown. The varied line density creates the impression of a natural setting, possibly a forested area with dense foliage and sparse clearings for light to penetrate.

artworks.title: Shepherd Struggling with a Goat (Berger luttant avec sa chevre)
artworks.description: The image shows a coastal area from a slightly elevated perspective. The horizon is low and mostly hidden by the landscape's features. A steep hill or rocky cliff is on the right, sketched with diagonal hatching for texture. In the distance, a building sits on the hillside. Trees on the left are drawn with thin lines. A figure and an animal are off-center to the right, represented with quick strokes. The color palette is monochromatic, using black ink on a pale background.

artworks.title: Dreamer under Tall Trees (Le Reveur sous les grands arbres)
artworks.description: The image shows a view looking up at a series of tree-like forms depicted with densely layered vertical lines. The horizon is not visible, and there are no objects shown on it. The brushstrokes create a chaotic network of dark, swirling lines that overlap and crisscross, providing a sense of depth and form. The color palette is minimal, featuring dark brown or sepia ink against a beige or off-white background, creating a stark contrast. The strong linear presence gives a sense of texture and energy to the composition.

artworks.title: Souvenir of Antibes (Souvenir d'Antibes)
artworks.description: The image features a sketch of a landscape. In the foreground, at the bottom left, three figures are depicted. A large tree is drawn to the left of the figures. The land extends into the distance, where the horizon is visible with minimal detailing. The sketch is monochromatic with black ink on a light beige background. The artist's signature "COROT" is found at the lower right of the image.

artworks.title: Horseman Halted in the Countryside (Cavalier arrete dans la campagna)
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape drawing from a slightly upward perspective, capturing trees and a horizon with rolling lines indicating distant fields or meadows. Some small structures are near the horizon. The drawing uses cross-hatched lines and sketch-like strokes for texture and movement in the trees. The monochromatic color palette is sepia-toned against a light background. Trees in the foreground have intertwined branches over small figures and animals, with distant trees fading into the sky.

artworks.title: Boatman (Le Batelier)
artworks.description: The drawing depicts a view along a body of water. The perspective is slightly elevated, with a horizon line towards the top of the image. Trees with densely scribbled canopies are visible, along with some tall trees on the left and right sides. A small boat with a seated figure is on the water. The drawing is done using energetic and expressive lines, creating a sense of movement and texture. The color palette is monochromatic, with black ink on off-white paper, providing a sharp contrast.

artworks.title: Herding the Cows at Dusk (Vachère le soir)
artworks.description: The image is viewed from a slightly elevated perspective. The horizon is set above the center line, where a cluster of trees is situated in the distance. The brushstrokes are loose and swirling. The overall color palette is monochromatic, relying on a range of earthy sepia tones. Closest to us, the landscape is defined by grassy textures and a winding path leading towards a dense grouping of trees. The sky occupies the upper portion of the image, filled with dynamic, sweeping patterns.

artworks.title: John and Abigail Montgomery
artworks.medium: transparent and opaque watercolor and ink over graphite on wove paper
artworks.dimensions: sight size: 22.2 x 35.3 cm (8 3/4 x 13 7/8 in.)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Edgar William and Bernice Chrysler Garbisch
artworks.description: In the image, two people are seated facing each other across a wooden table. On the left, an older man is seated in a black suit with a white shirt, holding a walking stick. Across from him, a woman in a dress with a bonnet tied with a blue ribbon is seated. The table holds a top hat, an open book labeled "Holy Bible," a bowl of fruit, and closed books or boxes. A small dog is at the base of the table. The floor has a patterned rug, and the wall behind them displays garlands and a framed painting depicting a pastoral scene with a house and trees.

artworks.title: Birth and Baptismal Certificate for Anne Andres
artworks.medium: pen and brush and black and brown inks, watercolor, and brown wash on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Edgar William and Bernice Chrysler Garbisch

artworks.title: Cutout of Animals
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Edgar William and Bernice Chrysler Garbisch
artworks.description: Dozens of animals and eight people are arranged in a pattern resembling a family tree, so each side is mostly a mirror image of the other in this nearly square work made of watercolor and cut paper. The areas between the people and animals has been cut away so the manila-yellow paper behind shows through. The people have pale or tan-colored skin. The animals and birds face each other along the center axis, and some of the areas between the animals are filled in with vines or areas of topaz blue, teal green, off white, or butter yellow, speckled with dark dashes or polka dots. A band of green along the bottom reads as a grass ground, across which are arranged mirrored pairs of hump-backed camels, bears, groundhogs, and squirrels. At the center, a woman wearing a long tangerine-orange skirt riding a large brown dog faces a man wearing an aquamarine-blue shirt and cream-white pants riding astride a black dog. Up along the axis are pairs of peacocks, caribou, horses, stags, and giraffes. To either side are zebras, cats, foxes, cheetahs, goats, birds, lions, turtles, butterflies, and other animals. A pair of men in military uniforms face inward from the center to the left and right sides. Near the top, a woman and man stand or sit astride an elephant to either side. The people here have light brown skin and wear feathered headdresses.

artworks.title: Dr. John Bard
artworks.description: The image shows an older man in a side profile position. He has grey hair tied back, revealing his facial features. He is wearing a white shirt and a grey coat with red trim. The background is solid deep blue.

artworks.title: Thomas Tingey
artworks.artist: Charles B. J. Févret de Saint-Mémin
artworks.medium: etching and engraving with roulette on wove paper
artworks.description: The image shows a bust portrait of a person in profile facing right. The person appears mature with detailed facial features, styled hair, and is dressed in an ornate military uniform with a white cravat, decorated jacket, and elaborate epaulettes. The background is a simple, circular frame.

artworks.title: Head of a Woman Wearing a Striped Bonnet
artworks.description: The image depicts an engraved portrait of a woman's upper body in a shoulder-length view. She is facing slightly to the left, with her head turned towards the front, showing her facial features. Her hair is styled in short, tight curls framing her face, and she wears a bonnet with a striped pattern and frilled edges. The bonnet has a ribbon tied under her chin. She is wearing a dress with a broad collar and pleated pattern. The background features a solid, textured pattern within an oval shape. She is not wearing any visible jewelry or holding any objects.

artworks.title: John Bard
artworks.description: The image shows a man's profile view, focusing on his upper body. He is facing left and has distinct features such as a prominent nose and white hair styled straight. He is dressed in a brown coat over a white waistcoat with a cravat. The background is textured dark blue with light hints. No jewelry or objects are visible.

artworks.title: Mrs. John Bard
artworks.description: The image shows a woman from the mid-torso up in a profile position, facing right. She has a fair complexion, dark brown hair partially visible under a blue and white bonnet with lace details and ribbons. She wears a garment with a light shawl or collar around her neck, over a dark textured fabric gathered at the waist with a ribbon. The background is solid dark blue.

artworks.title: The Artist Drawing from the Model
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 23.4 x 18.2 cm (9 3/16 x 7 3/16 in.)
artworks.description: The image shows a sketch with a figure in the center, depicted from the back, with only the lower half of the body detailed and the rest only partially outlined. The person is standing and turned slightly to the right, with their facial features not clearly visible due to the light outline. They appear to have a cloth wrapped around their head. A palm frond is sketched beside them. To their right, another figure is seen from the side, waist up, turned towards the standing figure, draped in textured fabric. On the left, a crouching figure is sketched, shown from the side, wearing a head cloth and appearing to hold something close to them. The background is heavily shaded in the top half, suggesting a darker space, with abstract or unfinished elements surrounding the main figures.

artworks.title: Woman Reading
Landscape with a View Toward Haarlem (The Goldweigher's Field)
artworks.medium: etching and drypoint on laid paper [counterproof]
artworks.description: The image displays a rural landscape. The horizon is filled with trees and structures, including a building with a weather vane. Open fields are detailed with a variety of lines and textures, creating depth and shadow. The image is monochromatic and relies on line work for its visual impact. In the distance, there are clusters of trees and structures suggesting a more developed area.

artworks.title: The Holy Family with Saint Elizabeth and Saint John the Baptist
artworks.description: The image shows a detailed etching of four figures in a domestic setting. In the foreground, a woman is seated holding a baby. Beside them, a young child sits with a basket. To their right, another woman is engaged in handcraft. In the background, a man stands with his back to the viewer, wielding an axe. The scene includes scattered fabric and tools, with a simple architectural element in the background.

artworks.title: The Green Lizard of Jamaica (Lacerta bullaris)
artworks.medium: etching and engraving with hand coloring on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Dr. and Mrs. George Benjamin Green
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a lizard on a flowering plant. The image depicts a lizard on the branches of a plant with pinkish-red buds and small yellow flowers. The plant has green leaves and brown seed pods. The lizard is detailed, showing its scales and open mouth. The drawing is focused, detailed, and realistic, resembling botanical illustrations.

artworks.title: Ancienne porte du Palais de Justice, Paris (Old Gate of the Palace of Justice, Paris)
artworks.description: The image shows a medieval castle with three towers and pointed spires. One tower has an emblem with a dragon-like creature holding a banner with the word "PARIS." The drawing is detailed with fine lines and cross-hatching to depict the stonework and banners. In the background are more towers and architectural details suggesting a historical cityscape.

artworks.title: Le Ministère de la Marine, Paris (The Admiralty, Paris)
artworks.description: The image shows a view of a building with grand columns identified as the "Ministère de la Marine." The building occupies much of the space in the foreground, with people and horse-drawn carriages below. In the background, an obelisk and other structures can be seen. The sky is filled with flying figures and creatures amidst swirling clouds, depicted with intricate line work typical of etching. The color palette is monochromatic, using shades of black and white to create contrast and detail.

artworks.title: The Bather
artworks.description: The image shows a full-length view of a female figure seated on a rock. She is positioned sideways with her legs bent and extended downward, and her arms are behind her, supporting her weight. The figure is depicted with an elegant posture, her head turned slightly to the side, with her eyes closed. Her hair is styled in a short, soft wave, framing her face. The background is minimal, with the only details being the subtle texture suggesting the surface she is sitting on, and some lines below. There is no clothing or visible jewelry in this image, and subtle shading and lines complete the depiction.
